subject.title: [Security] Improper authorization check on subagent tool execution in src/mcp/plugin-tools-handlers.ts

question: Does the ACPX MCP bridge have a supported subagent-specific capability contract that must differ from the tool array supplied by its caller?
rationale: Current source confirms the handler executes its supplied tools but does not establish the intended authority contract or where caller scope should be enforced; changing this boundary needs security-owner intent.

options.title: Trace and validate the reported boundary
options.body: Map subagent creation to the MCP bridge and add a regression reproduction before selecting the enforcement point.

options.title: Consolidate with the loopback-scope report
options.body: If the traced path is the same mutable MCP scope boundary, preserve the evidence there and close this report as a duplicate.

options.title: Decline after source-level disproof
options.body: Close only if tracing shows restricted subagents cannot reach a parent-authorized tool set through this bridge.

recommendation.title: Trace and validate the reported boundary
recommendation.body: Map subagent creation to the MCP bridge and add a regression reproduction before selecting the enforcement point.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the active adjacent MCP authorization investigation and are the strongest available routing signal.
